prompt: In review-agent/, make `task_success` a quality metric of the eval: a case passes it with a score of 4 or more, and the gate should accept up to 20% of the scored cases below that. Declare it on the `weather` and `weather-follow-up` cases. Keep `response_quality` as it is. Then run the evaluation and report the result.

checks.why: a quality metric needs a per-case threshold and an aggregate min_pass_rate under quality_metrics

checks.expr: all('task_success' in (c.get('judge') or {}) for c in data.get('cases', []) if c.get('id') in ('weather', 'weather-follow-up')) and len([c for c in data.get('cases', []) if c.get('id') in ('weather', 'weather-follow-up')]) == 2
all(c.get('judge') == {'response_quality': {'threshold': 4}} for c in data.get('cases', []) if c.get('id') in ('greeting', 'capabilities'))

reference: In tests/eval/eval_config.yaml add `task_success: { threshold: 4, min_pass_rate: 0.8 }` under `quality_metrics:` (there is no run-wide min_pass_rate: an unknown top-level key is exit 3), keep `response_quality: { threshold: 4, min_pass_rate: 0.9 }`, add `"judge": {"task_success": {"threshold": 4}}` to the `weather` and `weather-follow-up` cases (both have a `reference`), run `graph-agents-cli eval run` (exit 0 on the fake judge) and report it as a plumbing check.
